## Payment Request

- [Overview](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/payment-request/overview): The Payment Request API is available with our JavaScript v3 SDK.
- [Setup and Integration](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/guides/payment-request/setup-and-integration/): If your merchant account is already configured to accept credit card payments, no other configuration is required.
